TEXT: [FI] What...

TEXT: [FI] I'll just say something honest...

TEXT: [FI] You have my heartfelt thanks for being worried about me...

TEXT: [FI] I see...

TEXT: [FI] But I don't understand your feelings.

TEXT: [FI] My... feelings?

TEXT: [FI] Yes. What were you really thinking when you're trying to stop me? And what's the origin of that thought? What do you gain from stopping me?

TEXT: [FI] Yes. I don't understand whatever it is that you're doing.

TEXT: [FI] You... You're really being a fool here.

TEXT: [FI] ...That's true. Perhaps we're both fools, you and I. Too foolish to be saved.

TEXT: [FI] Hey, even me?

TEXT: [FI] Isn't that a given?

TEXT: [FI] So you admit you're a fool too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I don't intend to pretend I'm a wise person at the very least. At any rate...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...It's fine, even if you don't get it. I didn't think that you would understand it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I see. Not... troubling people, that's a good thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] However, don't push yourself.

TEXT: [FI] That...I refuse.

TEXT: [FI] Why?

TEXT: [FI] It's because I'm a creator.

TEXT: [FI] ...Huh? What does that mean...

TEXT: [FI] It's just like walking in the dark, there is no such thing as a definite answer. Although some paths are indeed better than others, always close by us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] And to continuously look for those is our purpose, as creators.

TEXT: [FI] Even so, surely you don't have to push yourself to that extent?

TEXT: [FI] No, that is necessary. You won't understand since you're not a creator.

TEXT: [FI] You weren't so exhausted when you were working on that game the previous time...

TEXT: [FI] ...This is being too hard on yourself...

TEXT: [FI] Even though that's the case...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's fine like this. Because this is what I've wished for.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I'll definitely create a good piece of work when I experience such hardships...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That is what I firmly believe in...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Isn't that a wrong assumption? Just because you're going through tough times, you're using that reason to comfort yourself?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Who knows? However, it's true that many creators had walked on the same path.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] And so, I will walk upon this path too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's with that?! Creation or whatever, is there only suffering in creating?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] No, I don't just feel pain. There's the many types of joy I'm experiencing too, which is why I'm able to endure this suffering.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Endure... Are you training to be a monk?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I guess... This might even come close to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's just suffering for different objectives. They devote themselves to the Gods, and I devote myself to my masterpieces. That's the only difference.

TEXT: [FI] Say... Just a little, any bit will do... is there anything I can help out with?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If you put it that way... all the more reason I can't just leave you alone...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I think there's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So this pain shall be mine and mine alone. This is my creation, so that's why, this pain is something that only belongs to me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why are you keeping that all to yourself?

TEXT: [FI] I can have the sense of pride precisely because there's that sense of hardship. Because that's what I produced.

TEXT: [FI] I want proof. An absolute proof for my transcending work.

TEXT: [FI] You're putting that face on again... I'm serious.

TEXT: [FI] ....You're serious?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Heh... Obviously. No matter how much you worry about me, it's pointless. Did you finally get it?

TEXT: [FI] Our kind is greedy. To the point that ordinary people think of it as madness.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's why you won't stop?

TEXT: [FI] Yes, exactly.
